_comment: Expected AltDSS-schema divergences: fragments where the PORT's schema intentionally differs from the pinned 0.14.5 oracle because the port's engine adopted newer (dss_capi 0.15.x / OpenDSS r4133) behavior. Each `divergences` entry is a per-property diff (port_extra_line / port_extra_property / port_hidden_property / port_changed_line) that golden_schema.rs applies to the port's rendered class def before byte-comparing against the oracle golden, FAILING if the count no longer matches (stale entry) or an unexplained diff remains. `port_authored_classes` lists whole classes whose port schema diverges STRUCTURALLY from 0.14.5 (r4133/0.15.x restructures or a new class) and are therefore NOT byte-gated vs the oracle — their port bytes are pinned by schema_full_port.json and full_document_matches_port_golden; the split is fail-on-stale (every DSS_CLASS_LIST_ORDER class must be in exactly one of SCHEMA_CLASSES or this list). Only documented upstream causes are admissible — this is NOT a tolerance. Regenerate the oracle side via tools/golden/gen_schema.py.

port_authored_classes.cause: The port's LineGeometry follows the newer dss_capi (0.15.x): the classic `Wires` prop becomes Redundant+SuppressJSON and a new `Conductors` object-ref-array (index 20) is the JSON member, plus the props straddle 0.14.5 via HIDE_015X. Its schema diverges structurally from the pinned 0.14.5 oracle (different property model), so it is pinned to the port's own bytes rather than byte-gated.

The port ports OpenDSS r4133-trunk Relay (75 props: PhCurve/OC_GndCurve/PhPickup renamed from the 0.14.5 PhaseCurve/GroundCurve/PhaseTrip, plus DOC_*/SinglePhTrip/Lock/RatedCurrent/InterruptingRating/per-phase Normal/State arrays), diverging structurally from the pinned 0.14.5 oracle (53 props, classic names). Pinned to the port's bytes.

The port ports OpenDSS r4133-trunk Recloser (46 props: PhaseFast/PhaseDelayed/GroundFast/GroundDelayed/... renamed to PhFastCurve/PhSlowCurve/GndFastCurve/GndSlowCurve/... with classic names kept as deprecated aliases, plus MechanicalDelay/SinglePhTrip/Lock/Reset/RatedCurrent/InterruptingRating), diverging structurally from the pinned 0.14.5 oracle (24 props, classic names). Pinned to the port's bytes.

This engine follows the 0.15.x/r4133 SwtControl model (Normal->NormalState, State->PresentState per-phase arrays instead of the shared 0.14.5 CurrentAction, and the State GetState 'no controlled element -> CTRL_NONE' getter semantics), plus the r4133 RatedCurrent prop and the 0.15.x help catalog (deprecated Delay, per-phase Normal/State help). The per-phase model is real: Normal/State are MappedStringEnumArray properties rendered one token per controlled-element phase, so this schema spells them `type: array` + `items: $ref` where dss_capi 0.14.5 spells a scalar `$ref` with a default, the same array shape this engine emits for Relay's Normal/State. No `default` key is emitted for either: the emitter elides one for any property flagged NO_DEFAULT (State) or DYNAMIC_DEFAULT (Normal), which is decided before the sample object is read (classes.rs no_default), and the sample SwtControl would give an empty array anyway (it has no controlled element, hence array_size 0). Relay's Normal is elided by the same DYNAMIC_DEFAULT flag, and its State getter carries r4133's `ControlledElement <> Nil` guard, so the sample's array is empty too. The whole class is therefore pinned to this engine's bytes.

WindGen is this engine's 50th class (from r4133, registered after Generator), absent from dss_capi 0.14.5 (49 classes) entirely. Its schema is authored here (no 0.14.5 schema to compare) and pinned to this engine's own bytes. The metadata answers to the r4133 trunk (NumPropsThisClass=44 + 4 inherited = 48 rows, UserModel/UserData at 18/19), not to the un-vendored dss_capi 0.15.x 'cleaned' rewrite (windgen/mod.rs).

divergences.cause: dss_capi 0.15.x / OpenDSS r4133 flags LineCode FaultRate/PctPerm/Repair as Deprecated+Unused (a LineCode never propagated them to its Lines, unused in the engine since 2014). This engine follows the newer engines (prop_flags.rs::DEPRECATED), so its schema emits `deprecated: true`. The pinned dss-python 0.15.7 backend (dss_capi 0.14.5) predates the flag and omits it.

dss_capi 0.15.x / OpenDSS r4133 adds CNData.SemiconLayer (CNData.pas, `SemiconLayer = 5`): existence of a semicon layer between insulation and the concentric-neutral strands, affecting shunt self-admittances. The port adopted it (conductor_data/cn_data.rs); the pinned dss_capi 0.14.5 backend (CNData `TProp` ends at RStrand=4) has no such property, so it is inserted at ordinal 5, shifting every following $dssPropertyIndex/$dssPropertyOrder down by one vs the oracle.

A LineSpacing takes no property before its first nconds=, so its JSON record writes NConds and the import applies it first. dss_capi 0.14.5 suppresses LineSpacing.NConds from its JSON (no block, no $dssPropertyOrder) and its import sizes every array to the default 3 wires, so a four-wire spacing comes back with three. This engine renders the NConds block at $dssPropertyIndex 1 / $dssPropertyOrder 2, which moves the order of every later LineSpacing property up by one. Pinned by exec::tests::line_geometry_rules::a_short_spacing_list_keeps_its_gaps (the NConds key and its import) and ::a_spacing_property_before_nconds_is_refused.

dss_capi 0.15.x / OpenDSS r4133 adds the LineSpacing equivalent-spacing model (LineSpacing.pas): Detailed selects per-conductor coordinates (x/h arrays) vs the four equivalent-distance fields. The port adopted it (line_spacing/mod.rs); pinned dss_capi 0.14.5 (LineSpacing `TProp` ends at units=5) lacks it.
dss_capi 0.15.x / OpenDSS r4133 LineSpacing equivalent-spacing model: geometric-mean distance between phase conductors. Implemented in line_spacing/mod.rs, absent from dss_capi 0.14.5.
dss_capi 0.15.x / OpenDSS r4133 LineSpacing equivalent-spacing model: geometric-mean distance between phase and neutral conductors. Implemented in line_spacing/mod.rs, absent from dss_capi 0.14.5.
dss_capi 0.15.x / OpenDSS r4133 LineSpacing equivalent-spacing model: average height of phase conductors. Implemented in line_spacing/mod.rs, absent from dss_capi 0.14.5.
dss_capi 0.15.x / OpenDSS r4133 LineSpacing equivalent-spacing model: average height of neutral conductors. Implemented in line_spacing/mod.rs, absent from dss_capi 0.14.5.

dss_capi post-0.14.5 (git 69fca934 'Transformers: fix handling of X23 and X13 (trap zero wasnt triggering)') added TPropertyFlag.NonZero to XfmrCode X12/X13/X23; the 0.14.5 tag has [RequiredInSpecSet] only. The vendored .inputs/dss_capi carries the NonZero flag (byte-spec), so the port emits `exclusiveMinimum: 0` for the three impedances (each in the 'X12, X13, X23' oneOf); the pinned dss-python 0.15.7 backend (dss_capi 0.14.5) predates the flag and omits it. First tag containing 69fca934: 0.14.6a1.

dss_capi 0.15.x (r3902/r3913) adds EpsRMedium, the LineConstants medium relative permittivity. This engine carries it as a HIDE_015X prop (line/mod.rs): the schema/JSON dump hide it (build.rs, byte-exact vs the 0.14.5 goldens), but it occupies $dssPropertyIndex 31 / $dssPropertyOrder 27, shifting the following NormAmps..Enabled props down by one vs dss_capi 0.14.5 (whose Line TProp ends the general data before it).

dss_capi 0.15.x (Line.pas r3902/r3913) adds HeightOffset — a conductor height offset for the LineConstants Z build. HIDE_015X port-only prop (see EpsRMedium), $dssPropertyIndex 32 / $dssPropertyOrder 28, absent from the pinned 0.14.5 oracle.

dss_capi 0.15.x (Line.pas r3902/r3913) adds HeightUnit — the LineUnits code HeightOffset is expressed in. HIDE_015X port-only prop (see EpsRMedium), $dssPropertyIndex 33 / $dssPropertyOrder 29, absent from the pinned 0.14.5 oracle.

dss_capi 0.15.x (Line.pas:62,341-344) adds Conductors — the merged mixed wire/CN/TS object-reference-array (the 0.15.x spacing-spec-set member that replaced Wires). The port carries it as a HIDE_015X forward-compat prop (line/mod.rs); the 0.14.5 schema/JSON dump hide it and keep emitting the legacy Wires prop under the JSON key 'Conductors' (json_name masquerade). It occupies $dssPropertyIndex 34 / $dssPropertyOrder 30, the fourth of the four 0.15.x props shifting NormAmps..Enabled down; absent from the pinned 0.14.5 oracle. (The anchor is indent-precise so the Wires-as-Conductors oneOf member is not miscounted.)

The vendored dss_capi snapshot (newer than the pinned 0.14.5 oracle backend) adds Units_kvar to Capacitor.kvar — dss_capi commit 90c572e4 'AltDSS-Schema: More units' (verified: 0.14.5 tag has `[RequiredInSpecSet]`, the vendored .inputs/dss_capi has `[RequiredInSpecSet, Units_kvar]`). The port follows the vendored spec, so its schema emits `units: kvar`; the pinned dss-python 0.15.7 backend (dss_capi 0.14.5) predates it. (Reactor.kvar's Units_kvar predates 0.14.5, so its `units: kvar` is byte-exact — this diff is Capacitor-specific.)

OpenDSS r4064 (dss_capi 90962ae8) GICharm BH-curve data: Transformer BHpoints/BHcurrent/BHflux, inserted after Ratings (ordinal 49) before the inherited PD/CktElement tail. The port carries them as SUPPRESS_JSON forward-compat parse targets (transformer/mod.rs), so they render no schema block but occupy $dssPropertyIndex 50-52, shifting every following prop's index +3 vs the 0.14.5 oracle (whose Transformer TProp ends at Ratings=49). $dssPropertyOrder is unaffected (SUPPRESS_JSON excludes them from AltPropertyOrder).
OpenDSS r4064 (dss_capi 90962ae8) GICharm BH-curve data (see the BHPoints entry): Transformer BHcurrent, SUPPRESS_JSON port-only prop at $dssPropertyIndex 51, absent from the 0.14.5 oracle.
OpenDSS r4064 (dss_capi 90962ae8) GICharm BH-curve data (see the BHPoints entry): Transformer BHflux, SUPPRESS_JSON port-only prop at $dssPropertyIndex 52, absent from the 0.14.5 oracle.

OpenDSS r4133 registers AutoTrans XfmrCode as its 39th own property, between bank and XRConst, and answers it with the auto's own TAutoTransObj.FetchXfmrCode: the Transformer's routine plus a forced SERIES/WYE connection on the first two windings, the XHL/XHT/XLT -> puXHX/puXHT/puXXT rename and RdcSpecified on every winding. dss_capi 0.14.5 and 0.15.x have no such row, so their table is 52 names long against this engine's 53. This engine implements the property (elements/pd/auto_trans) but flags the row HIDE_R4133: it renders no schema block while occupying $dssPropertyIndex 39 / $dssPropertyOrder 32 (HIDE_R4133 keeps a row in AltPropertyOrder, like the Line 0.15.x rows; on AutoTrans the order rank runs seven below the index because Windings and the six redundant plural array forms are dropped from AltPropertyOrder while Like is hoisted to rank 1 -- Bank is 38/31, XRConst 40/33). Both fields are this property's OWN ordinal ranks, the convention the four Line rows use: the renumbering shifts a following prop by the count of removed ranks STRICTLY BELOW it, so a rank that is off by one is absorbed whenever the slot below is occupied and the byte gate cannot see the error. Measured by regeneration: the prop at index 39 / order 32 without the row (XRConst) sits at 40 / 33 with it.

OpenDSS r4064 (dss_capi 90962ae8) GICharm BH-curve data: AutoTrans BHpoints/BHcurrent/BHflux, inserted after ppm_Antifloat/pctRs before the inherited PD/CktElement tail (mirrors the Transformer BHPoints entry). The port carries them as SUPPRESS_JSON forward-compat parse targets (auto_trans/mod.rs), so they render no schema block but occupy $dssPropertyIndex 43-45, shifting every following prop's index +3 vs the 0.14.5 oracle (whose AutoTrans TProp ends the general data at pctRs). $dssPropertyOrder is unaffected (SUPPRESS_JSON excludes them from AltPropertyOrder).
OpenDSS r4064 (dss_capi 90962ae8) GICharm BH-curve data (see the AutoTrans BHPoints entry): BHcurrent, SUPPRESS_JSON port-only prop at $dssPropertyIndex 44, absent from the 0.14.5 oracle.
OpenDSS r4064 (dss_capi 90962ae8) GICharm BH-curve data (see the AutoTrans BHPoints entry): BHflux, SUPPRESS_JSON port-only prop at $dssPropertyIndex 45, absent from the 0.14.5 oracle.

OpenDSS r4086 (dss_capi 8a898cba) replaced RegControl's kWRevPowerThreshold field (+100 kW default) with a signed RevPowerThreshold (W) field, Units_kW + PropertyScale 1000, defaulting to -100000 W = -100 kW (reg_control/mod.rs). The port adopted r4086, so its RevThreshold default is -100; the pinned 0.14.5 oracle emits +100.

OpenDSS r4086 (dss_capi 8a898cba) added RegControl idle-zone flags. Idle suppresses tap changes inside a power dead-band (reg_control/mod.rs); absent from the pinned 0.14.5 oracle (whose RegControl TProp ends at Cogen=32).
OpenDSS r4086 (dss_capi 8a898cba) RegControl idle-zone flag IdleReverse (reg_control/mod.rs); absent from the pinned 0.14.5 oracle.
OpenDSS r4086 (dss_capi 8a898cba) RegControl idle-zone flag IdleForward (reg_control/mod.rs); absent from the pinned 0.14.5 oracle.
OpenDSS r4086 (dss_capi 8a898cba) added RegControl's forward-power threshold FwdPowerThreshold (W), Units_kW + scale 1000, default 100 kW (reg_control/mod.rs); absent from the pinned 0.14.5 oracle.

dss_capi commit 90c572e4 'AltDSS-Schema: More units' adds Units_kW to Generator.kW ([RequiredInSpecSet] -> [RequiredInSpecSet, Units_kW]); the pinned dss-python 0.15.7 backend (dss_capi 0.14.5) predates it and omits the unit. The port follows the vendored source (generator/mod.rs). kW appears in both spec sets ('kW, pf' and 'kW, kvar'), so the line renders twice in the oneOf. (Same 'More units' wave as the Capacitor.kvar divergence.)

dss_capi commit 90c572e4 'AltDSS-Schema: More units' adds Units_kvar to Generator.kvar ([NoDefault, RequiredInSpecSet] -> [+ Units_kvar]); the pinned dss_capi 0.14.5 backend predates it. The port follows the vendored source (generator/mod.rs). kvar appears only in the 'kW, kvar' spec set, so the line renders once in the oneOf.

OpenDSS r4133 still registers Generator Rneut/Xneut immediately after conn (help 'Removed due to causing confusion - Add neutral impedance externally'), so its table is 50 names long, while dss_capi 0.14.5 has no such rows. This engine carries them as UPSTREAM_STUB + HIDE_R4133 rows (elements/pc/generator/mod.rs): the write stores the string and logs 5611/5612, nothing else. They render no schema block but occupy $dssPropertyIndex 16-17 and $dssPropertyOrder 17-18 (HIDE_R4133 keeps them in AltPropertyOrder, like the Line 0.15.x rows; on Generator the order rank runs one above the index because Like is hoisted to order 1 - Conn is 15/16, Status 18/19), shifting Status..Enabled down by two vs dss_capi 0.14.5. Both fields are this property's OWN ordinal ranks, the convention the four Line rows use (EpsRMedium 31/27): the renumbering shifts a following prop by the count of removed ranks STRICTLY BELOW it, so a rank that is off by one is absorbed whenever the slot below is occupied and the byte gate cannot see the error.
OpenDSS r4133 Generator Xneut (see the Rneut entry): UPSTREAM_STUB + HIDE_R4133 port row at $dssPropertyIndex 17 / $dssPropertyOrder 18, absent from the pinned 0.14.5 oracle.

OpenDSS r4133 still registers Sensor Action as its 13th and last own property (help opening 'NOT IMPLEMENTED.'), so its table is 16 names long, while dss_capi 0.14.5 comments it out ('action = 13 // unused'). This engine carries it as an UPSTREAM_STUB + HIDE_R4133 row (elements/meter/sensor/mod.rs): the write stores the string silently (Set_Action has an empty body in r4133). It renders no schema block but occupies $dssPropertyIndex 13 / $dssPropertyOrder 13 (on Sensor the two hoists cancel - Like to order 1, the BooleanAction Clear to the end - so a prop's order rank equals its index: Weight is 12/12, BaseFreq 14/14), shifting BaseFreq/Enabled down by one vs dss_capi 0.14.5.

divergences.from:
"default" : "none",
      "description" : "Name of the TCC Curve object that determines the fuse blowing.  Must have been previously defined as a TCC_Curve object or specified as \"none\" (ignored). If \"none\", fuse sampling will be skipped and device will not blow for any current level. Default is \"none\". Multiplying the current values in the curve by the \"CurveMultiplier\" value gives the actual current.",
divergences.to:
"default" : "tlink",
      "description" : "Name of the TCC Curve object that determines the fuse blowing.  Must have been previously defined as a TCC_Curve object. Default is \"Tlink\". Multiplying the current values in the curve by the \"RatedCurrent\" value gives the actual current.",
divergences.cause: OpenDSS r4133 Fuse TCC model: FuseCurve defaults to "none" (dss_capi 0.14.5: "Tlink") and its help names "CurveMultiplier" as the divisor instead of "RatedCurrent". This engine follows r4133 (elements/pd/fuse), dss_capi 0.14.5 keeps the classic default/help.

divergences.from:
"default" : 0.0000000000000000E+000,
      "description" : "Fuse continuous rated current in Amps. Defaults to 0. Not used internally for either power flow or reporting.",
divergences.to:
"default" : 1.0000000000000000E+000,
      "description" : "Multiplier or actual phase amps for the phase TCC curve.  Defaults to 1.0.",
divergences.cause: OpenDSS r4133 makes Fuse.RatedCurrent a purely informational continuous rating (default 0.0, 'Fuse continuous rated current in Amps') where dss_capi 0.14.5 has the TCC divisor (default 1.0, 'Multiplier or actual phase amps'), and the CurveMultiplier prop takes the divisor role. This engine follows r4133, dss_capi 0.14.5 keeps the old RatedCurrent semantics.

OpenDSS r4133 has the Fuse TCC-curve current multiplier CurveMultiplier (GetTCCTime(Cmag/CurveMultiplier)), default 1.0, in the divisor role RatedCurrent has in 0.14.5. This engine implements it (elements/pd/fuse/mod.rs). dss_capi 0.14.5 (Fuse TProp ends at State=10) lacks it, so it sits at ordinal 11, shifting the following BaseFreq/Enabled/Like $dssPropertyIndex/$dssPropertyOrder down.

OpenDSS r4133 has the informational Fuse rated interrupting current InterruptingRating (default 0.0, not used internally). This engine implements it (elements/pd/fuse/mod.rs). It is absent from dss_capi 0.14.5 and sits at ordinal 12.

OpenDSS r4133 defaults DynamicExp NVariables to 20 memory rows (General/DynamicExp.pas:305), so an equation that names its VarNames and omits the count integrates. The port adopted the r4133 default (elements/general/dynamic_exp.rs, DEFAULT_N_VARIABLES). The pinned 0.14.5 oracle defaults it to 0.

User decision 2026-10-04: a rating that is not set is its own value, not a number. Nothing gives a GICTransformer a current rating, so the port's schema writes no default for NormAmps. The pinned 0.14.5 oracle writes 0 as the default. Pinned by unset_ratings_read_none_by_default.

divergences.from: "description" : "One of (ohms per ...) none, mi, kft, km, m, me, ft, in, cm or mm, written whole, me reading as m. Default is none, which assumes units agree with length units given in Line object.",
divergences.to: "description" : "One of (ohms per ...) {none|mi|km|kft|m|me|ft|in|cm}.  Default is none; assumes units agree with length units given in Line object",
divergences.cause: A length unit is one exact word of the OpenDSS documentation, mm included, no prefixes. This engine's LineCode.Units reads only the words none, mi, kft, km, m, me, ft, in, cm and mm, each written whole, and its help lists them. dss_capi 0.14.5 prints the wheel's list, which omits mm. Pinned by linecode_units_help_lists_the_accepted_words.

A LineSpacing coordinate list holds the values given, in order, and a conductor it does not reach has no position. A new spacing has none given, so this engine's X and H render no default. dss_capi 0.14.5 sizes both lists to the default three conductors and renders a default of three zeros. Pinned by a_short_spacing_list_keeps_its_gaps.
